title: Check generated-receipt presence before reading
failure_signature: A future x2 runner-validation receipt was read before the x2 ledger transition and receipt generation occurred.
candidate_workaround: Test for output presence, append the intended Method Flow transitions, then generate and read the validation receipt in that order.
recurrence_guard: Do not infer or read a stage receipt before its generating transition has completed.
rollback: Retain the absent-file attempt and make no validation claim.
protected_gates: No validation claim from absent receipt
scope_boundary: This method validates receipt-ordering control flow only and proves no external claim.
